propositions: The s3 optional extra must be declared in pyproject.toml as git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 with a note that it ships the remote helper and is never required by core rebar.
A runtime availability guard require_s3_helper() must verify both that the git-remote-s3 console script is on PATH and that the installed distribution version meets the >=0.3.2 minimum.
The version comparison logic must be stdlib-only, parsing leading numeric components as a tuple and treating non-numeric/unparseable versions as failing the minimum requirement.
Missing or incompatible installs must raise OptionalDependencyError with an actionable message containing the exact string pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]'.
The s3 EXTRAS entry in _optional.py must probe the git_remote_s3 importable package name so that guard_import() can detect its presence, even though rebar never calls the package API.
The implementation must remain stdlib-only with no dependency on packaging or git_remote_s3 itself.
